opponent.label: Mina
opponent.description: Mina Ha had it all, until she had even more in her sights. Marriage, royalty, power--all stolen from her by an assassin's bullet. Her parents, seeking only the best for their daughter, contracted a vampire to turn Mina into the undead and grant her eternal life. Now learning her new powers and navigating vampire high society, Mina's ambitious eye is set on becoming the next Viscount of New York.
